Requirement_Summary: Dedicated permission sets: Sample_Rep, Sample_Manager, Sample_Admin, Sample_Auditor (read-only), Sample_Integration, UCPMP_Compliance_Officer, UCPMP_Executive_Signatory.
SF_Evidence: Only force-app/main/default/permissionsets/Sciagen_Sample_Admin.permissionset-meta.xml exists (full CRUD on 9 Sample_* objects + Manage_Sample_Inventory custom permission). Rep-level access comes from the generic, non-sample-scoped Sciagen_Mobile_App_Access.permissionset-meta.xml (78 objects). No Sample_Manager, Sample_Auditor, Sample_Integration, UCPMP_Compliance_Officer or UCPMP_Executive_Signatory permission set exists anywhere in permissionsets/ (11 sets total, ls-confirmed).
iOS_Evidence: Permission sets are a Salesforce-side concept; the iPad app has a single hardcoded rep persona in RootView.swift with no manager/admin/auditor UI mode.
Risk_Notes: Naming an existing Sciagen_Sample_Admin permission set 'Sample_Admin' vs creating parallel new ones needs a decision to avoid a 2nd admin tier; new sets (Manager/Auditor/Integration/Compliance Officer/Executive Signatory) are net-new work with no existing template beyond the FLS pattern already used.

Requirement_Summary: Sample_Lot__c and Sample_Transaction__c OWD Private with owner+role-hierarchy+admin visibility; reps cannot edit the calculated on-hand quantity or delete transactions or edit submitted records.
SF_Evidence: OWD Private confirmed on both objects (Sample_Lot__c/Sample_Lot__c.object-meta.xml, Sample_Transaction__c/Sample_Transaction__c.object-meta.xml). Sciagen_Mobile_App_Access grants Sample_Lot__c Read-only (no Create/Edit/Delete) and Sample_Transaction__c Create/Read/Edit but not Delete (01_inventory_salesforce.md S12.3). Available_Quantity__c is maintained only by SampleTransactionService.afterSave (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:290-297), not directly user-editable. lockedEditsAllowed() (SampleTransactionService.cls:108-115) blocks edits to type/product/lot/qty/status/to/from once Inventory_Applied__c=true, manager override only. Gap: no Apex-managed sharing (__Share) rows found for either object (S3.2/S12.2 of inventory), so beyond owner + role hierarchy no territory-based widening exists, and the live role hierarchy itself is UNVERIFIED from source (no roles/ directory).
iOS_Evidence: No Sample_Lot or Sample_Transaction data model exists client-side at all (02_inventory_ios.md S2 table: exhaustive grep for Lot/SampleLot/SampleTransaction/Inventory/Allocation returns zero matches) so there is nothing to scope visibility on.
Risk_Notes: Confirming the real role hierarchy (sf project retrieve -m Role) is a prerequisite before assuming manager-level visibility works as designed.

Requirement_Summary: Submitted calls/transactions are immutable except via Admin Unlock or Adjustment paths.
SF_Evidence: Transactions: SampleTransactionService.lockedEditsAllowed (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls:108-115) enforces immutability post-apply, sample-manager override only -- EXISTS. Calls: SupportCallRelockTrigger.trigger + SupportUnlockService.afterCallSubmit (Call_Visit_Report__c) provide a generic call-unlock mechanism gated by the Support_Unlock_Calls custom permission (01_inventory S1.16/S3.4), but this is a support-desk unlock, not the sample-admin-specific Unlock_Call_Policy (Require Second Signature / Adjustment Only / Both Allowed) the spec describes -- that config and its UI do not exist.
iOS_Evidence: CallReviewView's captureSignature() (Views/CLMViews.swift:1092-1094) just appends a boolean AttachmentRef; no lock of the samples/promo section after signing was found, so there is nothing to 'unlock' on device yet.
Risk_Notes: Building Unlock_Call_Policy on top of the existing Support unlock trigger risks colliding with the unrelated Support-desk workflow if not cleanly separated.

Requirement_Summary: iPad device security: data encrypted at rest (Data Protection Complete), biometric re-auth for the signature padlock and idle-timeout app reopen, jailbreak detection, remote wipe on deactivation.
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement.
iOS_Evidence: Auth tokens correctly use Keychain with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly (Services/SalesforceAuthService.swift:502-566) -- but the compliance-sensitive payload (signature strokes, consent records) is stored in a plaintext UserDefaults JSON blob, not an encrypted file (Services/UserDataStore.swift:1661,1670; 02_inventory_ios.md S7), directly conflicting with the encrypted-at-rest expectation for exactly this data. Zero LAContext/biometry usage anywhere (grep-confirmed), no NSFaceIDUsageDescription in Info.plist -- no biometric re-auth exists at all. No jailbreak detection (grep-confirmed). No MDM/remote-wipe hooks; the closest analogue is a manual OTP-gated Device Reset Request workflow (Services -> SciagenDeviceResetController.cls / DeviceResetRequestHandler.cls) that wipes on explicit user+manager action, not automatic remote wipe on deactivation.
Risk_Notes: Moving signature/consent data out of UserDefaults into an encrypted store is a breaking data-migration change for any rep with unsynced local data; must ship a migration path, not a silent cutover.

Requirement_Summary: Audit trail on all sample orders/transactions: Field History Tracking + append-only Sample_Ledger_Entry__c with a hash chain (each entry hashes the previous) and a nightly integrity-verification job.
SF_Evidence: Field History Tracking is explicitly DISABLED (<enableHistory>false</enableHistory>) on Sample_Lot__c (object-meta.xml:150), Sample_Transaction__c (object-meta.xml:150) and Call_Visit_Report__c (object-meta.xml:149) -- the opposite of the spec's 'enable Field History Tracking on every compliance field' instruction. Sample_Transaction__c functions as a working ledger (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls) with device/IP metadata (Client_Id__c, Device_Type__c, IP_Address__c) and Sample_Blocked_Attempt__c + Sample_Attempt__e (platform event, durable via EventBus.publish independent of the DML rollback, classes/SampleDropService.cls:67) give a good partial audit trail for refusals. But there is no dedicated append-only Sample_Ledger_Entry__c object, no hash or hash-chain field anywhere in the codebase (repo-wide grep for hash/ledger found nothing matching), and no nightly integrity-verification batch job (only SampleLotExpiryBatch and HcpLicenseExpiryBatch are scheduled).
iOS_Evidence: No ledger concept exists client-side (no Sample_Transaction model on device).
Risk_Notes: Turning on Field History Tracking retroactively does not back-fill history for past changes; a hash chain needs its own object and a one-time bootstrap of a genesis entry -- plan this before any real sample transactions are recorded in production.

Requirement_Summary: Third-party auditors can perform inventory audits and reconcile ledger vs lots vs disbursements.
SF_Evidence: No Sample_Auditor permission set exists anywhere in force-app/main/default/permissionsets/ (ls-confirmed). No physical-inventory-count object exists in the schema at all -- Sample_Inventory__c / Sample_Inventory_Item__c are absent from the full 101-object listing (01_inventory_salesforce.md S1.23) -- so there is no count data to reconcile against the ledger yet.
iOS_Evidence: No auditor persona or inventory-count concept exists client-side.
Risk_Notes: Depends on SM-INV (inventory-count object, out of this agent's scope but owned by another part of the audit) being built first; an auditor role with nothing to audit is not useful on its own.

Requirement_Summary: Retention minimum 5 years, or longer while any complaint/proceeding is open; legal-hold flag per HCP/product/period blocks archival.
SF_Evidence: No retention-period field, no legal-hold flag, and no complaint-tracking object found anywhere (repo-wide grep for 'complaint' across classes/objects returned zero hits). The only retention job in the codebase, classes/SyncTrackingPurgeJob.cls, purges the unrelated Sync_Tracking__c mobile-sync-log object after 90 days (RETENTION_DAYS=90, cls:19) -- the opposite policy of what SM-AUD-03 needs, and a hazard if ever mistakenly pointed at sample/ledger data.
iOS_Evidence: Retention/legal-hold is a server-side data-governance concern.
Risk_Notes: None today (no data exists to be at risk of premature deletion yet) -- but must be in place before production sample data accumulates, since Salesforce has no default undelete window matching a 5-year requirement.

Requirement_Summary: Complaint evidence pack (UCPMP 10-11): given a complaint (HCP, product, date range, rep), generate all disbursements/signatures/consent/licence-at-time-of-drop/counts/ledger-integrity-proof as PDF+CSV within the 30-day response window; track complaint id/received/due/status.
SF_Evidence: No Complaint object, no complaint workflow, and no evidence-pack generator anywhere in the codebase -- the only PDF-generation precedent found is the unrelated annual UCPMP Annexure (UCPMPDisclosureController.cls / UCPMPDisclosureForm.page) and AccountPlanExportPdf.page.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Depends on SM-AUD-01's ledger integrity proof and SM-LIC's licence-at-time-of-drop snapshot both existing first; building the evidence pack before those exist would just re-surface today's gaps.

Requirement_Summary: (5.1(ii)) Free samples only to a person qualified to prescribe that product.
SF_Evidence: SampleEligibilityService.licence() (classes/SampleEligibilityService.cls:100-111) blocks when hcp.Can_Prescribe__c != true, citing UCPMP 5.1(ii) in the error text (cls:102-103) -- a real, working check. But it is a blanket 'can this person prescribe anything' flag; there is no per-product Eligible_Prescriber_Credentials__c field on Product__c to check the HCP is qualified to prescribe THIS specific product/class.
iOS_Evidence: No licence/prescriber-qualification check exists anywhere in the iOS sample flow; CallReviewView's samplesCard (Views/CLMViews.swift:818-881) has no eligibility gate at all beyond the (non-blocking) yearly-count warning.
Risk_Notes: Depends on Product__c gaining an Eligible_Prescriber_Credentials__c-equivalent field, which does not exist today.

Requirement_Summary: Rep-distributed samples handed directly to the prescriber or an authorized receiver; HCP name and address recorded.
SF_Evidence: HCP_Name__c and HCP_Address__c are auto-snapshotted on every transaction (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls, defaults() at :84-93). Sample_Transaction__c.Authorized_Recipient_Name__c and Handed_To_Prescriber__c fields exist but are free-text/boolean with no governing 'Authorized Receiver' record type or validation -- no Account_Authorization__c-equivalent object exists in this org.
iOS_Evidence: No received-by / authorized-receiver capture exists anywhere in the samples card UI.
Risk_Notes: Needs a new Account_Authorization__c-style object (record type Authorized Receiver) that does not exist today; low risk to existing data since it is additive.

Requirement_Summary: (a) Purpose limited to creating awareness of treatment options / acquiring experience; purpose statement recorded.
SF_Evidence: No purpose-statement field found on Product__c, Sample_Transaction__c, or the signing statement (classes/SampleDropService.cls:148 only covers the 'not for sale' legend, not a purpose statement).
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: None; purely additive text field + UI copy.

Requirement_Summary: (b) Pack limited to prescribed dosage for <=3 patients for the required course of treatment (Units_Per_Sample_Pack vs Course_Of_Treatment_Units x Max_Patients_Per_Pack, validated at product setup).
SF_Evidence: Product__c.Max_Patients_Per_Pack__c exists, but there is no Course_Of_Treatment_Units__c field and no validation rule cross-checking Pack_Size__c against it -- Product__c has zero entries in objects/Product__c/validationRules/ (directory absent, confirmed). The field exists; the rule it should drive is not enforced anywhere.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Needs a new field + a validation rule on Product__c; no data migration since Product__c only has 12 records today (per org data counts in 01_inventory_salesforce.md).

Requirement_Summary: (b) <=12 sample packs per drug per HCP per year, counted across all reps and all channels, company-wide, server-authoritative, offline-aware.
SF_Evidence: SampleLimitSeeder.cls:9-10 seeds a hard-block, regulatory Sample_Limit__c (Limit_Scope__c='HCP_Product', Limit_Quantity__c=12, Limit_Period__c='Financial_Year', Hard_Block__c=true, Is_Regulatory__c=true, Regulatory_Reference__c='UCPMP 2024 Clause 5.1(ii)(b)'). SampleLimitChecker.cls counts usage from completed disbursements by HCP+Product (not by owning rep), so it is genuinely company-wide across channels, and SampleLimitGuardService.cls:10-23 blocks any attempt to delete/relax/disable/raise a regulatory limit. Product__c.Max_Packs_Per_HCP_Per_Year__c is separately honoured too (SampleLimitChecker.cls:8-9 doc comment).
iOS_Evidence: Services/CLMData.swift:20-32 hardcodes an entirely different, non-UCPMP yearly cap for exactly 3 named products (Emrok 48/yr, Glaritus 36/yr, Miqnaf 60/yr -- not 12), computed only from CVRs already present on the local device (Services/UserDataStore.swift:663-669, can under-count) and is display-only: the over-limit flag never gates Save/Submit (Views/CLMViews.swift:1050-1070). This actively contradicts both the '12' figure and the 'company-wide, server-authoritative, hard block' requirement.
Risk_Notes: The iOS hardcoded limits/UI must be entirely replaced, not extended, to avoid shipping a rule that silently permits 4x-5x the legal UCPMP cap; this is the single highest-risk conflict in scope.

Requirement_Summary: (c) Each pack marked 'free medical sample not for sale' (legend confirmed on product/lot before activation).
SF_Evidence: Sample_Transaction__c.Marked_Not_For_Sale__c defaults true (object-meta.xml, description cites UCPMP 5.1(ii)(c)) and SampleDropService.SIGNING_STATEMENT (classes/SampleDropService.cls:148) literally states "They are marked 'free medical sample not for sale'" at the acknowledgement step -- good runtime evidence of the legend being communicated. But there is no product- or lot-level 'legend confirmed' attestation gating lot activation as the spec requires; the field just defaults true with no check against actual packaging.
iOS_Evidence: No legend text or attestation anywhere in the client (Capture Signature is a bare boolean).
Risk_Notes: Low risk, additive: needs a Free_Sample_Legend_Confirmed__c-equivalent field on Product__c/Sample_Lot__c plus a validation rule blocking lot activation until set.

Requirement_Summary: (d) Sample pack <= smallest pack sold in the market.
SF_Evidence: Product__c.Smallest_Market_Pack_Size__c exists (description cites UCPMP 5.1(ii)(d)), but nothing enforces Pack_Size__c <= Smallest_Market_Pack_Size__c anywhere -- Product__c has no validationRules directory and neither SampleEligibilityService nor SampleTransactionService reference Smallest_Market_Pack_Size__c at all.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Additive validation rule only; no data migration needed given the 12-record Product__c catalog today.

Requirement_Summary: (e) Adequate system of accountability and control (covered by transaction ledger, counts, reconciliation).
SF_Evidence: The transaction ledger (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls) covers the disbursement side, but there is no physical-inventory-count object (see SM-AUD-02) and therefore no ledger<->count reconciliation -- the 'accountability and control system' is only half-built.
iOS_Evidence: N/A (no counts, no reconciliation client-side).
Risk_Notes: Directly dependent on SM-AUD-02 / SM-INV inventory-count objects being built.

Requirement_Summary: (f) No samples of hypnotics, sedatives or tranquillizers -- hard block.
SF_Evidence: Product__c.Is_Restricted__c + Restriction_Reason__c (picklist value 'Hypnotic_Sedative_Tranquillizer') exist, and both SampleEligibilityService.check() (classes/SampleEligibilityService.cls:54-57) and SampleTransactionService.validateAndDecide() (cls:143) hard-block whenever Is_Restricted__c=true, citing UCPMP 5.1(ii)(f). The mechanism works, but enforcement is entirely dependent on an admin manually ticking the generic Is_Restricted__c checkbox for the right reason -- there is no dedicated, self-enforcing Therapeutic_Restriction__c classification, so a hypnotic/sedative/tranquillizer product left with Is_Restricted__c=false would sample without any error. Flagged as a CONFLICT risk against the spec's 'can never be sampled' guarantee, not just a gap.
iOS_Evidence: No restricted-product concept exists anywhere in the iOS sample flow; the hardcoded CLMData.swift catalog would not reflect a live Is_Restricted__c change even if it existed.
Risk_Notes: Recommend adding a dedicated, mandatory Therapeutic_Restriction__c picklist on Product__c (not just the free-text Restriction_Reason__c) so 'hypnotic' is a first-class, queryable classification rather than admin-discretionary -- this closes a real compliance exposure.

Requirement_Summary: Maintain per-supply record: product name, doctor name, quantity, date of supply; report available anytime.
SF_Evidence: Sample_Transaction__c captures Product__c, HCP_Account__c/HCP_Name__c, Quantity__c and Performed_At__c on every disbursement (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls), and UCPMPComplianceController.getHcpReport()/UCPMPComplianceService.getHCPReport() (classes/UCPMPComplianceService.cls:82-105) expose a live per-HCP/product report at any time via the ucpmpComplianceDashboard LWC.
iOS_Evidence: The SampleDrop push payload sends only CVR__c/Product__c/Qty__c (Services/SalesforceRestDataService.swift:2446-2469) -- no lot, no per-line date beyond the parent CVR's visitDate, no HCP-registration snapshot -- so the client captures a subset of what the server-side record already holds.
Risk_Notes: SF side is solid; iOS just needs to capture/display more of what the server already models, low risk.

Requirement_Summary: Monetary value of samples <=2% of domestic sales per year; compliance dashboard with alerts at configured thresholds, optional block at 100%.
SF_Evidence: UCPMPComplianceService.getExpenditureSummary() (classes/UCPMPComplianceService.cls:56-80) computes percentOfSales, percentOfCap and a status (Within/Approaching/Exceeding) against SampleConfig.twoPercentCap() -- a real, working 2% dashboard (ucpmpComplianceDashboard LWC / UCPMP_Compliance_Page). Gaps: the 'Approaching' threshold is hardcoded at 80% in Apex (cls:75) rather than the spec's configurable [50,75,90,100] thresholds, and there is no block-at-100% enforcement hook anywhere (dashboard-only, does not stop a disbursement).
iOS_Evidence: No 2%-cap visibility exists anywhere on device.
Risk_Notes: Making the alert thresholds configurable and optionally wiring a hard block at 100% are both additive; low risk to existing behaviour.

Requirement_Summary: (5.1(g), Circular 3/2025) Per-unit valuation at price to stockist (own manufacture) or purchase price (bought-in), annual average by dosage form/strength, provisional vs final at FY close.
SF_Evidence: Product__c.Sample_Unit_Value_INR__c (description: 'price to stockist for own manufacture, purchase price for bought-in product (UCPMP 5.1(ii)(g))') is snapshotted onto Sample_Transaction__c.Unit_Value_At_Transaction__c at disbursement (classes/SampleTransactionService.cls, defaults() at :81), and Total_Value__c is documented as packs x units per pack x per-unit value -- the core per-unit-at-time-of-supply mechanic exists. Gaps: only a single current-value field per product (no FY-scoped price master, no separate price-to-stockist vs purchase-price fields, no computed 'annual average'), and no provisional-vs-final variance tracking at FY close (Valuation_Method__c picklist exists but no wired logic was found using it).
iOS_Evidence: SampleDrop has no value/price field at all client-side.
Risk_Notes: Building a proper FY-scoped price master (SM-PRD-05 in the full spec) is a prerequisite; retrofitting it after go-live means every already-snapshotted Unit_Value_At_Transaction__c would need reconciling against the new provisional/final model.

Requirement_Summary: (5.1(i)) Informational/educational items <=Rs.1,000 per item, no independent commercial value.
SF_Evidence: No informational-item object, Product_Type__c value, or Unit_Value_INR__c cap check exists anywhere; Product__c has no field distinguishing 'informational item' from a sample.
iOS_Evidence: PromoDrop (Models/CLMModels.swift:284-288) has no value field or cap at all; RCPA's Personal Order Booking similarly has zero quantity/value governance (1...500 flat stepper, RCPAViews.swift).
Risk_Notes: None; fully additive, but needs both a new product classification and a hard-block validation, mirroring the SM-UC-09 restricted-product pattern.

Requirement_Summary: (8.1-8.4) No gifts for personal benefit, pecuniary advantage, travel, hospitality or cash via the sample/promo channel.
SF_Evidence: No Personal_Benefit__c flag or any blocking logic found on Product__c or elsewhere.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Additive product flag + block, mirrors SM-UC-09's pattern; low risk.

Requirement_Summary: (14.2) Rules apply to medical devices too.
SF_Evidence: No Is_Medical_Device__c field exists on Product__c; all existing rules implicitly apply to whatever is flagged Is_Sample_Product__c regardless of device vs drug, so devices are not distinguished (nor excluded) today.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Additive field; existing rules already run against any Is_Sample_Product__c record so the practical enforcement gap is smaller than the missing field alone suggests.

Requirement_Summary: (4.4-4.5) Reps (incl. contract reps) acknowledge the UCPMP code on first login each FY; sampling blocked until acknowledged.
SF_Evidence: No acknowledgement field, object, or gate found anywhere -- repo-wide grep for 'acknowledg' matches only the unrelated disbursement SIGNING_STATEMENT text (classes/SampleDropService.cls:148), not a rep-level annual attestation. No 'contract rep' flag exists on Rep Roster (which itself does not exist as an object in this org).
iOS_Evidence: N/A.

iOS_Evidence: Compliance-officer/admin function, correctly out of scope for the iPad field app.

Requirement_Summary: Submitted by the executive head to the member association (or its own website); if a member of several, submit to one and intimate the others; stay with the same association unless membership ceases and DoP+first association are notified.
SF_Evidence: No association-membership tracking, no submission-workflow object, and no UCPMP_Executive_Signatory permission set exists. UCPMP_Tenant_Config__c only holds static Signatory_Designation__c/Signatory_DIN_or_PAN__c/Signatory_Email__c/Signatory_Mobile__c text fields that pre-fill the PDF -- there is no actual 'submit' action, association list, or intimation-letter generator.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Requires a new association-membership object plus a submission-workflow object; none of the underlying data model exists today.

Requirement_Summary: If not a member of any association, submit via the DoP UCPMP portal; record the portal submission reference.
SF_Evidence: No portal-submission-reference field or object found anywhere.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Small, additive once SM-DIS-02's submission-workflow object exists.

Requirement_Summary: Lock the disclosure after filing; amendments create a new version with reason; keep all versions >=5 years.
SF_Evidence: UCPMPComplianceService.generateDisclosureForm() (classes/UCPMPComplianceService.cls:143-147) is a stateless render (Page.UCPMPDisclosureForm.getContentAsPDF()) with no persisted UCPMP_Disclosure__c record anywhere in the schema (confirmed absent from the full object listing) -- there is no version number, no lock flag, and no history: every generation is a fresh, unlocked, unversioned PDF. This directly conflicts with the 'lock after filing, version on amendment' requirement.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: This is the biggest structural gap in the disclosure area: it needs a whole new persisted, versioned, lockable UCPMP_Disclosure__c object behind the existing PDF renderer, not just a UI tweak.

Requirement_Summary: Every number in the form links (drill-down) to the underlying ledger rows (HCP, product, date, qty, unit value).
SF_Evidence: The underlying data is queryable and UCPMPComplianceController.getHcpReport() (classes/UCPMPComplianceController.cls:27) already exposes a per-HCP/product breakdown table via the ucpmpComplianceDashboard LWC -- a de facto drill-down view sits alongside the PDF today. But the PDF itself (pages/UCPMPDisclosureForm.page) has no embedded links back to source rows, and Sample_Expenditure_Tracking__c stores pre-aggregated totals (Tracking_Key__c likely one row per HCP+Product+FY) rather than a queryable link to individual Sample_Transaction__c rows.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Low risk: the dashboard drill-down UI is a good starting point to extend into the PDF/Excel output rather than building from scratch.

Requirement_Summary: Transitional/extension dates (e.g. regulator-granted deadline extensions) configurable without code.
SF_Evidence: No extension-date configuration field exists on UCPMP_Tenant_Config__c or elsewhere; the deadline itself is not modeled at all (see SM-DIS-01), so there is nothing to extend yet.
iOS_Evidence: N/A.
Risk_Notes: Trivially additive once SM-DIS-01's deadline model exists; sequence after that item.

Requirement_Summary: Offline-first local store (SwiftData/Core Data) holding lots, transactions, receipts, inventories, products, My Setup, accounts/addresses/licenses in territory + supervising physicians, authorizations, consents, limits & UCPMP counters, settings, labels.
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement.
iOS_Evidence: Persistence is Codable structs serialized to a single JSON blob in UserDefaults, not SwiftData/CoreData (Services/UserDataStore.swift:1732-1757,1771-1774, header: "Holds the current Sales Rep's private data and persists it locally (UserDefaults)"). Separately and more fundamentally, no Lot/SampleLot/SampleTransaction/Inventory/Allocation data model of any kind exists anywhere in the client (02_inventory_ios.md S2, exhaustive grep confirms zero matches outside unrelated fields). Both the storage technology and the data model itself conflict with/are absent against this requirement.
Risk_Notes: This is the largest single iOS gap: the whole sample-inventory data layer (lots, transactions, receipts, counts) needs to be built from nothing, and UserDefaults-blob persistence for this volume/sensitivity of data should not be extended, it should be replaced (SwiftData per the spec) -- a genuine architecture change, not a feature add.

Requirement_Summary: Sync engine: delta sync via Apex REST (/sciagen/samples/v1/...), outbox queue with client-UUID idempotency keys, auto-sync on save when online, conflict policy = server wins for compliance fields with user-visible messages.
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement (server REST side covered under SF architecture, out of this agent's §14-19 scope focus but noted).
iOS_Evidence: A generic, genuinely solid sync engine already exists: delta pull via LastModifiedDate (classes/SciagenAccountSyncService.cls:85, confirmed zero SystemModstamp usage), push via createOrUpdate() PATCH/POST keyed on a known salesforceId making retries idempotent (SalesforceRestDataService.swift:2805-2821), 'Salesforce wins' conflict policy on pull-back (documented at multiple UserDataStore.swift comment sites), and auto-sync-on-save wiring (SciagenCRMApp.configureAutosync(), SciagenCRMApp.swift:194-240). Gaps: no /sciagen/samples/v1/... endpoint exists (existing REST resources are /sciagen/v1/accounts, /savedViews, etc.); Sample_* objects are entirely absent from the 13-record Sync_Object_Config__mdt table that drives what syncs (01_inventory_salesforce.md S6.1) -- so the reusable pattern currently has zero sample-specific wiring; and idempotency relies only on local salesforceId state, not an explicit client-UUID header as the spec specifies.
Risk_Notes: The sync pattern itself is safe to extend; the risk is entirely in the net-new work (new REST resource, new Sync_Object_Config__mdt records, new local models) rather than in touching the existing generic engine.

Requirement_Summary: Shared Swift rules engine mirroring server rules (same rule IDs/messages via synced labels); contract tests run the same JSON fixtures against Apex and Swift.
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement (Apex side is SampleEligibilityService/SampleLimitChecker, functioning and documented as the offline mirror's authority per its own header comment).
iOS_Evidence: No shared/dedicated rules engine exists. The only 'rule' found is the hardcoded, display-only 3-product yearly-limit check in Services/CLMData.swift:20-32 / Views/CLMViews.swift:818-881, which does not block save/submit and uses different numbers from the real UCPMP rule (see SM-UC-05). No contract-test fixtures shared between Apex and Swift were found (no unit-test target exists in the iOS project at all -- 02_inventory_ios.md S9).
Risk_Notes: This is a large net-new component and a hard dependency for SM-UC-05/09/12 etc. working offline at all; also blocked by the total absence of an iOS unit-test target needed for the spec's contract tests.

Requirement_Summary: Screens: My Samples hub, Pending Receipts, Transfer/Return/Adjustment forms, Inventory count, Transactions list, Call->Samples & Promo mass add, Lot picker, Barcode scanner, Warning popovers, Signature page (padlock/swap/GPS/receipt email), Supervising Physician picker, Opt-in (in-person+remote, pending list), Remote Sampling, Account sample-status badge, New Account wizard, Allocations, Inventory Orders (search+sort).
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement.
iOS_Evidence: Only a bare-bones 'Samples card' (product Menu + qty stepper, Views/CLMViews.swift:818-881) exists inside CallReviewView. None of the listed screens exist: no My Samples hub, Pending Receipts, Transfer/Return/Adjustment forms, Inventory count, Transactions list, Lot picker, Barcode scanner, Cold-chain UI, BRC ship-to picker, Supervising Physician picker, Remote Sampling, Account sample-status badge, Allocations, or Inventory Orders search/sort. A general multichannel consent capture screen (ConsentCaptureView.swift) exists but is not the UCPMP sample opt-in warning/banner tied specifically to a Call with samples.
Risk_Notes: Almost the entire iPad screen surface for this module needs to be built; sequence behind SM-IOS-01 (data model) and SM-IOS-03 (rules engine) since these screens depend on both.

Requirement_Summary: Permissions: camera, location; graceful denial handling.
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement.
iOS_Evidence: Camera permission (NSCameraUsageDescription) and a real UIImagePickerController flow exist for DCR proof-photo capture (Views/ImagePicker.swift:14-46) -- reusable pattern, but not VisionKit/AVFoundation barcode scanning (confirmed absent by grep, needed for SM-BAR). CoreLocation is real and working, When-In-Use only (Services/LocationService.swift, full 118-line read, 25s one-shot timeout) -- reusable for a signature-page GPS stamp, but not currently wired to any sample-specific feature.
Risk_Notes: Low risk: both permission primitives already exist and work; the gap is wiring them to new sample features (barcode scanner, signature GPS stamp), not building permission handling from scratch.

Requirement_Summary: Accessibility (Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels on status colours -- never colour-only), localisation-ready, iPhone compact layouts.
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement.
iOS_Evidence: No localization infrastructure exists at all (zero NSLocalizedString/LocalizedStringKey usage, no .lproj/.xcstrings files -- 02_inventory_ios.md S8), conflicting with the spec's synced-label/translatable model. No Dynamic Type support (zero @ScaledMetric/dynamicTypeSize usage against ~98 fixed-point .font(.system(size:)) call sites). Only 6 accessibility modifiers exist app-wide, none on any status-colour indicator -- directly conflicts with the 'never colour-only' requirement this module explicitly repeats (SM-CALL-07, SM-LIC-08). Dark Mode is force-disabled (.preferredColorScheme(.light), SciagenCRMApp.swift:143) because of a fixed light-only colour system.
Risk_Notes: This is an app-wide architectural gap, not a per-screen fix -- every new Sample Management screen built without first addressing the colour-system/localization foundation will inherit and compound the same conflicts, so this should be resequenced ahead of, not alongside, SM-IOS-04's new screens.

Requirement_Summary: Activity log for scans and key sample events; crash-safe signature capture (persist strokes as they are drawn).
SF_Evidence: iOS-only requirement.
iOS_Evidence: No barcode scanning exists so there is nothing to log for that half. A general SyncLogEntry/SyncLogView audit trail does exist (Services/UserDataStore.swift + Views/SyncLogView.swift, 299 lines) covering many record types, but does not call out Sample_Drop or 'key sample events' as a distinct category. Crash-safe signature capture: the CVR's own 'Capture Signature' action is literally just a boolean flag with no stroke data captured at all (captureSignature(), Views/CLMViews.swift:1092-1094), so there is nothing to persist incrementally there; the two real signature pads that do exist (Consent, RCPA) hold strokes in an in-memory SwiftUI @State array during drawing and only write to the UserDefaults blob on explicit save -- a crash mid-signature loses the in-progress drawing, i.e. not crash-safe as the spec requires.
Risk_Notes: The generic SyncLogView pattern is a reasonable base to extend for sample-event logging; crash-safe signature persistence needs a genuinely new incremental-save mechanism since neither existing signature pad has one.
